rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); the native Nodal port needs immutable embedded PNG sprites to decode and upload once per graphics backend rather than on every knob frame. The Pulp canvas target has not adopted a Vellum package. This adds a static-storage image draw API and a focused two-frame cache test; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
